# Duolingo Podcast

> > Audio storytelling for Spanish and French language learners featuring real-life stories from Latin America, Spain, and beyond.

The Duolingo Podcast offers intermediate-level language learners compelling narrative episodes told in Spanish and French, with English narration to aid comprehension. Each episode features authentic stories about art mysteries, cultural traditions, personal journeys, and community experiences across Spanish-speaking regions including Peru, Venezuela, Spain, and Miami.

## Key Topics

- Spanish language learning
- Audio storytelling
- Intermediate learners
- Latin American culture
- Multilingual content
- Real-life narratives
- Cultural traditions
- Community stories
- Art and history
- Rural Peru
- Venezuela
- Spain
- Photography and literacy
- Personal identity stories

## Overview

- [Podcast - Duolingo](https://podcast.duolingo.com/): Duolingo podcasts homepage for Spanish & French learning stories

## Spanish Podcast Episodes

- [Spanish Podcast Episodes - Art & Culture](https://podcast.duolingo.com/spanish13.html): Spanish episodes on Matisse art forgery mystery from Venezuela to Miami
- [Spanish Podcast Episodes - Traditions](https://podcast.duolingo.com/spanish3.html): Spanish episodes on bullfighting & recorte tradition in Spain
- [Spanish Podcast Episodes - Rural Life](https://podcast.duolingo.com/spanish12.html): Spanish episodes on literacy & photography in rural Peru
- [Spanish Podcast Episodes - Community Stories](https://podcast.duolingo.com/spanish20.html): Spanish podcast episodes featuring coronavirus stories & community tales
- [Spanish Podcast Episodes - Personal Journeys](https://podcast.duolingo.com/spanish24.html): Spanish episodes featuring personal stories including hair acceptance
